name: Altar of the Broken God
story: A traveller wants his bag back from the altar.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A traveller stands below the altar. His food bag lies at the priest's feet.

beforeStory.speaker: Priest
beforeStory.text: Only the wounded may ask for a different fate.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The traveller checks the bread inside. He offers them some before leaving.

name: Deathless Gallery
story: In the gallery, every ending is followed by another challenge.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Two immortals face each other in the gallery. One yields, then changes his mind before the other can leave.

beforeStory.speaker: Immortal
beforeStory.text: Again. That was not the ending.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith stays by the gallery door, watching the two immortals.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: He turns away and follows her.

name: Court of the False Emperor
story: The Emperor offers Mara a destination, with a condition attached.

beforeStory.speaker: False Emperor
beforeStory.text: You have lost your place. I can give you a new one.

beforeStory.speaker: False Emperor
beforeStory.text: He may remain here in your service. A small arrangement.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: You have not asked either of us.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: For a moment I wanted him to know where I belonged.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: He knew where he wanted us to stand.

name: The Threefold Oracle
story: Three voices offer Mara three incompatible memories.

beforeStory.speaker: First Voice
beforeStory.text: The person you waited for came.

beforeStory.speaker: Third Voice
beforeStory.text: There was never anyone to wait for.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Then why were my shoes wet?

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I will keep what I remember. They can keep their answers.
